full_text_zh:
[P1] 爱花的牛
文/曼罗·里夫 图/罗伯特·劳森 译/孙敏
二十一世纪出版社

[P2] 凶猛之牛
费迪南

[P3] 从前，在西班牙，

[P4] 有一头小公牛，名字叫作费迪南。

[P5] 其他的公牛爱跑、爱跳、爱抵角。

[P6] 只有费迪南不喜欢

[P7] 他喜欢静静地坐着，
闻闻花香。

[P8] 牧场外的那棵栎树下，
是他最喜欢的地方。

[P9] 他可以一整天都坐在树荫下，闻着花香。

[P10] 有时，费迪南的妈妈担心，他总是
这么独自呆着，会觉得孤单。

[P11] “你可以和小伙伴们一起玩，一起跳，一起抵角呀。”
费迪南摇摇头：“我更喜欢静静地坐着，闻闻花香。”

[P12] 他的妈妈是个善解人意的好妈妈
（尽管她是牛妈妈），她看到费迪南
不觉得孤单，就由着他自己呆着，自得其乐。

[P13] 一年又一年，费迪南渐渐长大了，
变得越来越强壮。
费迪南
2岁
费迪南
1岁
3个月
1周

[P14] 那些和他一起长大的公牛们成天打架，
用角去刺对方。他们最大的
心愿是参加马德里的
斗牛大赛。

斗牛大赛
地点：
马德里斗牛场

[P15] 只有费迪南不感兴趣，他还是喜欢
静静地坐在栎树下，闻闻花香。

[P16] 一天，牧场里来了
五个戴着奇怪帽子
的人。

他们要挑选个头最大，
跑得最快，最凶猛
的公牛去参加斗牛大赛。

[P17] 公牛们不停地跑来跑去，
跳上跳下，还摇晃着脑袋，
鼻子里呼呼地喷气，像是
在说：“看，
我多么强壮，
多么凶猛啊，选我吧！”

[P18] 费迪南知道自己不会被选中，
他一点也不在乎，又跑到
心爱的栎树底下去了。

绘本在线
5vyk.5d6d.com

[P19] 当他正要往下坐时，
没想到他不是坐在
树荫下那凉凉
的草地上，而是
坐到了一只
大黄蜂身上。
RL

[P20] 如果你是费迪南，有一头公牛坐在你身上，
你会怎么办？当然是蛰他了！
大黄蜂就是这么干的！

[P21] 哇，好痛啊！
费迪南“嗖”地一下跳
了起来。他发疯似的跑着、
跳着，不停地喷气，还拿角刨地。

[P22] 看到费迪南，五个人兴奋地叫起来：“终于找到最大最凶猛的公牛了！让他参加马德里斗牛大赛准没错！”

[P23] 他们把费迪南装在马车上带走了。
马德里

[P24] 多么美妙的一天啊！
斗牛大赛就要开始了。
彩旗飞舞，乐队不停地在演奏……

[P25] 可爱的女士们，头上戴着一朵朵花。
贵宾席
费迪南
猛之牛

[P26] 出场式开始了。

[P27] 首先出场的是花镖手。
他们会用锋利的系着丝带的花镖
去刺公牛，让他生气。

绘本在线
5vyk.5d6d.com

[P28] 接着，好几个人骑着瘦瘦的马上场了，他们会用长矛戳公牛，让他更生气。

[P29] 终于，斗牛士登场了！他得意洋洋地，
以最帅的姿势向女士们鞠躬。
他披着红红的斗篷，手持一把利剑，
准备给公牛最后一击。

[P30] 公牛出场了。你知道公牛是谁吧？
是费迪南！

[P31] 他们称费迪南为“凶猛之牛”，
花镖手害怕他，长矛手害怕他，连斗牛士都吓呆了。

[P32] 费迪南跑到场中央，
观众们开始鼓掌、尖叫。
大家以为他是头凶猛无比的牛，
会疯狂地摇脑袋、喷气、拿角刨地。

[P33] 但是……费迪南看到了女士头上那些漂亮的花。
他静静地坐下来，闻着花香。

[P34] 不管斗牛士怎么刺激他，费迪南都不理会，
只是安静地坐着。花镖手生气了，
长矛手更生气，斗牛士气得发狂，
没有牛可以斗，他怎么用斗篷和
利剑炫耀自己呢？

[P35] 人们只好把费迪南送回家。

[P36] 直到现在，费迪南依然坐在他心爱的栎树下，静静地闻着花香。
他过得很幸福。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Bull Who Loved Flowers
Text by Munro Leaf  Illustrations by Robert Lawson  Translated by Sun Min
21st Century Publishing House

[P2] Fierce Bull
Ferdinand

[P3] Once upon a time, in Spain,

[P4] There was a little bull, whose name was Ferdinand.

[P5] The other bulls love to run, jump, and butt heads.

[P6] Only Ferdinand didn't like it.

[P7] He liked to sit quietly,
and smell the flowers.

[P8] Under that oak tree outside the pasture,
was his favorite place.

[P9] He could sit under the shade of the tree all day, smelling the flowers.

[P10] Sometimes, Ferdinand's mother worried that he was always
sitting alone like this and might feel lonely.

[P11] "You can play with your friends, jump together, and butt heads together." 
Ferdinand shook his head: "I prefer to sit quietly and smell the flowers."

[P12] His mother was a kind and understanding mother
(even though she was a cow mother). Seeing that Ferdinand
wasn't lonely, she let him be, enjoying himself.

[P13] Year after year, Ferdinand grew bigger and stronger.
Ferdinand
2 years old
Ferdinand
1 year old
3 months
1 week

[P14] Those bulls who grew up with him fought all day,
using their horns to jab at each other. Their greatest
wish was to participate in the bullfighting tournament in Madrid.

Bullfighting Tournament
Location:
Madrid Bullring

[P15] Only Ferdinand was not interested. He still liked
sitting quietly under the oak tree, smelling the flowers.

[P16] One day, five strange-looking men with odd hats came to the ranch.

They were looking for the biggest, fastest, and fiercest bull to enter the bullfighting contest.

[P17] The bulls kept running back and forth,
jumping up and down, shaking their heads,
and puffing out their nostrils, as if saying:
"Look,
how strong I am,
how fierce I am, pick me!"

[P18] Ferdinand knew he wouldn't be chosen,
he didn't care at all, and ran back
under his beloved oak tree.

Picture Book Online
5vyk.5d6d.com

[P19] As he was about to sit down,
he didn't expect to be sitting
on the cool grass under the tree,
but instead
on top of a big bumblebee.
RL

[P20] If you were Ferdinand, and a bull sat on you,
what would you do? Of course, you'd sting him!
That's exactly what the big bee did!

[P21] Wow, that hurts!
Ferdinand jumped up with a 'whoosh'. He ran and jumped wildly, breathing heavily and pawing the ground with his horns.

[P22] Seeing Ferdinand, the five men excitedly shouted: "Finally, we've found the biggest and fiercest bull! He's perfect for the Madrid bullfighting contest!"

[P23] They loaded Ferdinand onto a cart and took him away.
Madrid

[P24] What a wonderful day!
The bullfighting contest is about to begin.
Colorful flags are waving, and the band is playing nonstop...

[P25] Cute ladies, wearing flowers on their heads.
VIP Seats
Ferdinand
The Mighty Bull

[P26] The entrance ceremony has begun.

[P27] First to appear are the banderilleros.
They will use sharp, ribbon-tied banderillas
to prick the bull and make him angry.

Picture Book Online
5vyk.5d6d.com

[P28] Next, several people rode thin horses into the arena. They would use long spears to prod the bull and make him even angrier.

[P29] Finally, the matador makes his entrance! He proudly, 
in his most dashing pose, bows to the ladies.
He wears a bright red cape and holds a sharp sword,
ready to deliver the final blow to the bull.

[P30] The bull is out. Do you know who the bull is?
It's Ferdinand!

[P31] They called Ferdinand the 'Fierce Bull'.
The banderilleros were afraid of him, the picadors were afraid of him, and even the matador was stunned.

[P32] Ferdinand ran to the center of the arena,
the audience began to clap and shout.
Everyone thought he was a ferocious bull,
who would wildly shake his head, puff air, and charge with his horns.

[P33] But... Ferdinand saw the beautiful flowers on the ladies' heads.
He quietly sat down and smelled the flowers.

[P34] No matter how the matador tried to provoke him, Ferdinand paid no attention,
just sitting quietly. The picador was angry,
the banderillero even angrier, and the matador was furious—
with no bull to fight, how could he show off with his cape and
sword?

[P35] People could only send Ferdinand home.

[P36] Until now, Ferdinand still sits under his beloved oak tree, quietly smelling the flowers.
He is very happy.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《爱花的牛》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者及出版社信息，画面中央是一头黑色的牛站在花丛中，背景为红色并点缀白色花朵图案。
[P2] 画面展示了一幅张贴在墙上的海报，上面画着一头凶猛的公牛并写着“凶猛之牛 费迪南”，周围有许多孩子在围观、指指点点，背景是一座小镇和教堂。
[P3] 本页描绘了西班牙的乡村景象，山顶有城堡，山下有村庄和牛群，文字开启故事背景。
[P4] 本页介绍故事主角——一头名叫费迪南的小公牛，画面中它正低头闻着花丛中的花朵，背景是宁静的山坡和孤树。
[P5] 本页描绘了其他公牛活泼好动的场景，它们在草地上奔跑、跳跃和用角相抵，与主角费迪南形成对比。
[P6] 画面中，费迪南独自站在山坡上，周围只有几株小草和花朵，下方文字说明它与其他公牛不同，不喜欢奔跑和打闹。
[P7] 本页描绘了费迪南独自坐在花丛中，享受花香的宁静时刻，突显其与同伴不同的性格特点。
[P8] 本页描绘了费迪南独自走向牧场外的一棵栎树，文字说明那是他最喜欢的地方，突显其宁静、喜爱独处的性格。
[P9] 费迪南坐在一棵大树下，享受着树荫和花香，展现了他宁静、喜爱独处的性格。
[P10] 本页描绘了费迪南的妈妈担心他独自呆着会感到孤单，画面中费迪南站在草地上，背景是山坡和一棵树。
[P11] 费迪南的妈妈建议他和同伴们一起玩耍，但他拒绝了，表示更喜欢安静地坐着闻花香，展现了他与众不同的性格。
[P12] 费迪南的妈妈理解并尊重他喜欢独处的性格，看到他不孤单，便任由他独自享受宁静时光。
[P13] 本页描绘了费迪南随年龄增长而逐渐长大的过程，画面中他站在刻有成长标记的树旁，旁边有一只秃鹫，文字说明他一年年变得越来越强壮。
[P14] 本页描绘了费迪南的同伴们成天打架，梦想参加马德里的斗牛大赛，与费迪南的宁静性格形成鲜明对比。
[P15] 费迪南对同伴们的活动不感兴趣，依然喜欢独自坐在栎树下闻花香，展现其宁静独处的性格。
[P16] 牧场来了五个戴着奇特帽子的人，他们要挑选一头强壮、快速、凶猛的公牛参加斗牛大赛。
[P17] 公牛们为了被选中参加斗牛大赛，纷纷展示自己的强壮和凶猛，不停地奔跑、跳跃、喷气，试图吸引挑选者的注意。
[P18] 费迪南知道自己不会被选中参加斗牛大赛，毫不在意，又回到心爱的栎树下安静地待着，继续享受宁静时光。
[P19] 费迪南正要坐下时，意外地坐到了一只大黄蜂身上，画面从他的视角展现了这一突发状况。
[P20] 费迪南意外坐到大黄蜂身上，画面从他的视角展现其惊恐表情，文字以幽默口吻描述大黄蜂的反应。
[P21] 费迪南因意外坐到大黄蜂身上而受到惊吓，突然变得狂躁，开始疯狂奔跑、跳跃和用角刨地。
[P22] 费迪南因意外被大黄蜂蜇到而狂躁发作，五位挑选者误以为他凶猛强壮，兴奋地决定选他参加马德里斗牛大赛。
[P23] 费迪南被装上马车，由五位挑选者带往马德里，画面中可见通往马德里的路标。
[P24] 画面描绘了马德里斗牛大赛即将开始的热闹街景，彩旗飘扬，乐队演奏，人们从窗户和阳台上观看，营造出欢快而紧张的氛围。
[P25] 画面描绘了马德里斗牛大赛现场的贵宾席，女士们头戴鲜花，气氛热闹，旁边有标示‘费迪南 猛之牛’的牌子，暗示费迪南即将登场。
[P26] 斗牛大赛的出场仪式正式开始，画面中一名骑着装饰华丽马匹的号手正在吹响号角，宣告比赛的序幕。
[P27] 本页介绍了斗牛比赛的第一个环节，花镖手将用带丝带的花镖刺公牛以激怒它，画面展示了花镖手们列队入场的场景。
[P28] 本页描述了斗牛比赛的第一个环节，花镖手骑着瘦马入场，准备用长矛戳公牛以激怒它。
[P29] 斗牛士登场，他得意地向女士们鞠躬，披着红斗篷、手持利剑，准备对公牛进行最后一击。
[P30] 公牛费迪南从斗牛场的入口处登场，画面中可见其角尖从门后探出，上方有斗牛场的徽章。
[P31] 本页描绘了斗牛场内花镖手、长矛手和斗牛士面对费迪南时的恐惧反应，文字说明他们称费迪南为“凶猛之牛”，并因害怕而惊呆。
[P32] 费迪南进入斗牛场中央，观众们鼓掌尖叫，误以为他会表现出凶猛的攻击行为。
[P33] 费迪南进入斗牛场后，并未攻击观众，而是被女士头上的花吸引，安静地坐下闻花香。
[P34] 费迪南在斗牛场中无视斗牛士、花镖手和长矛手的刺激，安静地坐着，令他们因无法进行表演而气急败坏。
[P35] 费迪南在斗牛场中表现温顺，未参与斗牛表演，最终人们只好将他送回家。画面描绘了费迪南被装上马车，驶离斗牛场的场景。
[P36] 费迪南回到他心爱的栎树下，安静地闻着花香，过着幸福的生活。
